actions.q: Which states besides Connecticut and California have (or are planning) a baby bonds program?
actions.target: Which states besides Connecticut and California have (or are planning) a baby bonds program?

fact_basis.fact: Vermont's 'First Steps Forward' baby bonds is a pilot authorized by the Legislature in 2025 (H.55), 'currently in the fundraising phase'; covers Caledonia, Essex and Orleans counties; proposed model invests $3,200 for every Vermont child born on Medicaid; about 450 babies born July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2030; funds accessible ages 18-30 for Vermont home purchase, Vermont business, education/job training, or retirement
The same page names Connecticut as the only state with a statewide program ('first state to implement' in 2023)
Existing page text: Connecticut up to $3,200 HUSKY births, claim 18-30; California HOPE for Children Trust Account
fact_basis.source: page: How baby bonds work section
